topics.topic: Failure-classification boundary between component-level temporarily_unavailable and whole-request failure
questions: Which failures during an already-authorized overview are converted into a component-level `temporarily_unavailable`, and which still fail the whole request?
Which failures count as a failed overview part and are converted to `temporarily_unavailable`, rather than propagating through the normal Registry, persistence, input, or unexpected-failure mapping?
Which failures during each overview component must be converted to `temporarily_unavailable`, and which must still propagate through `error_policy` and fail the whole request?

judgement.why: This asks the same failure-classification question as P1, and neither the relevant texts nor the passages underlying that judgement have changed.

precedent.topic: Failure classes converted to temporarily_unavailable versus whole-request errors
quotes:
A21 (derived at read time, nothing persisted), A27 and Factory
`d2c4511ea119`: a part whose builder answers `ScopedNotFoundError` is
`not_configured`, a persistence or Registry failure `temporarily_unavailable`;
no zero is fabricated; viewer photos are client-visible only.
None of its own: every part's failure becomes its availability.
precedent.why: State 5 specifies that component-level persistence and Registry failures become temporarily_unavailable and that every part's failure is contained in its availability rather than propagated through the route's ordinary error mapping.

topics.topic: Propagation and retry semantics for a shared dependency failure across overview components
questions: When one failed read or calculation supplies several overview components, which components must become `temporarily_unavailable`, and may the shared dependency be read independently again for another component?

judgement.why: This asks the same shared-dependency propagation and containment question as P2, and neither the relevant texts nor the passages underlying that judgement have changed.

precedent.topic: Propagation and containment of shared-dependency failures across overview components
quotes:
`ProjectOverview`: six pairs — project, budget, expenses, progress, payments,
photos — each a `ViewAvailability` and a value present only when available.

A21 (derived at read time, nothing persisted), A27 and Factory
`d2c4511ea119`: a part whose builder answers `ScopedNotFoundError` is
`not_configured`, a persistence or Registry failure `temporarily_unavailable`;
no zero is fabricated; viewer photos are client-visible only.
None of its own: every part's failure becomes its availability.
precedent.why: State 5 makes availability independent per part: each builder that encounters the shared failure marks its own pair temporarily_unavailable, while parts whose builders do not fail remain available.
